root.short: A command line application to manage your Square Cloud applications

status.short: Check the Square Cloud platform health

list.short: List all snapshots from your account

commit.short: Make a commit for your application

info.short: View detailed information about your application

logs.short: View the most recent logs of your application

metrics.short: View CPU, RAM, network and disk metrics (24h or 7d)

realtime.short: Stream realtime events of your application (SSE)

domains.short: List every domain configured across your applications

load_balancers.short: List your custom domains grouped by application (load balancers)

root.short: Manage your applications with these commands

start.short: Send a start signal to start your application

restart.short: Send a restart signal to restart your application's process

stop.short: Send a stop signal to stop your application's process

status.short: View the status of your application

root.short: Manage all snapshots of your applications

create.short: Create a new snapshot of your application

restore.short: Restore your application from a snapshot

root.short: Manage the environment variables of your application

set.short: Set one or more environment variables

replace.short: Replace the entire set of environment variables

remove.short: Remove one or more environment variables

root.short: Manage the files of your application

list.short: List files in a directory of your application

read.short: Read a file from your application

write.short: Create or overwrite a file in your application

move.short: Move or rename a file in your application

delete.short: Delete a file from your application

webhook.short: Configure a GitHub webhook deploy integration

link.short: Link a repository through the Square Cloud GitHub App

root.short: Manage DNS, custom domain and edge observability

dns.short: View the DNS records required for your custom domain

domain.short: Set the custom domain of your application

analytics.short: View edge analytics of your application

errors.short: View edge error breakdown of your application

purge_cache.short: Purge the entire edge cache of your application

root.short: Manage the databases of your account

info.short: View detailed information about your database

update.short: Update the name or memory of your database

status.short: View the status of your database

root.short: Manage the credentials of your database

certificate.short: Print the TLS certificate of your database

reset.short: Rotate the password or certificate of your database

root.short: Manage all snapshots of your databases

create.short: Create a new snapshot of your database

restore.short: Restore your database from a snapshot

info.short: View members and applications of a workspace

add.short: Share an application with a workspace

remove.short: Remove an application from a workspace

root.short: Manage the members of a workspace

add.short: Add a member by invite code

update.short: Change the permission group of a member

remove.short: Remove a member from a workspace

invite_code.short: Generate your single-use invite code (valid for 5 minutes)

root.short: Manage your Square Cloud login with these commands

login.short: Log in to Square Cloud, required to run some CLI commands

whoami.short: View the username and account ID you are authenticated as

init.short: Create a squarecloud.app for the project in the current folder

upgrade.short: Update the CLI to the latest release

root.short: Manage your files in Square Cloud Blob

list.short: List your stored files, optionally under a prefix

upload.short: Upload a file (above 90 MiB it goes up in parts)

delete.short: Delete a stored file for good

url.short: Print a download link for a stored file

stats.short: Show how much Blob storage you use

root.short: Add Square Cloud to the Windows Explorer menu

install.short: Add "Send to Square Cloud" to the menu of folders and .zip files

uninstall.short: Remove the Explorer menu entry and every key it added

flags.file: File to upload instead of the current folder
flags.restart: Restart the application after the commit
flags.status_all_apps: Show the status of every application
flags.status_all_databases: Show the status of every database
flags.raw: Print raw numeric stats as JSON
flags.from_file: Read variables from a .env style file
flags.output: Write the content to a local file
flags.from: Read the content from a local file (default: stdin)
flags.start: Start of the window (RFC 3339, default: 24h ago)
flags.end: End of the window (RFC 3339, default: now)
flags.token: Log in with an existing Square Cloud API key
flags.with_token: Read the API key from stdin
flags.no_browser: Do not open the browser; only print the URL
flags.yes_switch_account: Replace a saved key of another account without asking
flags.db_type: Engine: mongo, mysql, redis or postgres
flags.no_wait: Don't wait for a restore that keeps running in the background
flags.range: Time range: 24h, or 7d on Pro and Enterprise plans
flags.follow: Keep printing new log lines as they arrive (Ctrl+C to stop)
flags.yes_init: Use the detected values without asking
flags.check: Only check whether a new version is available
flags.profile: Use the login saved under this profile (default: SQUARECLOUD_PROFILE, or default)
flags.blob_name: Object name, without the extension (default: the file name)
flags.blob_private: Store the file as private, reachable only through temporary links
flags.dry_run: Show what would change without changing anything
